name: h-a-clock-set-back-on-one-phone
working: The race is the gun, event 1. Every rounding names it.
The mark_1 phone tapped 412 (seq 2) at 12:10:00 on its clock, then its clock was set back (event 5, clock.changed, seq 3), then it tapped 887 (seq 4) at 12:08:40 and 5 (seq 5) at 12:08:50.

All three are level on 1 rounding and on one phone, so they are in the order that phone logged them, by seq: 412, 887, 5. By device time it would read 887, 5, 412, which is the order the clock set made up.
The ULIDs follow device time, as a phone mints them from its clock: 887's (…E) and 5's (…F) sort before 412's (…G). So a ULID order gives the wrong answer too, and only seq gives the right one.
One phone, so its clock needs no offset and clocks_unmatched is false.

The mark_2 phone's only station pick was made at 2026-10-23T11:00Z, the day before now in every time zone, so it is not stationed today and mark_2 is not waiting. mark_1 has roundings, so nothing is waiting.
